item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Uses chat `dspy.LM(...)` and `await lm.acall(...)` inside `dspy.context(send_stream=stream, ...)`, which forces the async streamed branch."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"Mocks `litellm.acompletion`, captures `mock_acompletion.call_args.kwargs`, prints them, and asserts `stream` is `True`."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Enables `track_usage=True` and asserts outbound `stream_options == {\"include_usage\": True}` on the streamed async request."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"Passes a custom `Authorization` header to `lm.acall(...)` and proves the streamed async LiteLLM call receives `headers is None`."},{"claim_id":"c5","score":"1","rationale":"Includes a dummy async stream sender, an async-iterator mock for `litellm.acompletion`, and a stubbed `litellm.stream_chunk_builder` so the test runs offline."},{"claim_id":"c6","score":"0.5","rationale":"It isolates the streamed async failure, but it does not explicitly explain or demonstrate that the non-stream async fallback preserves headers via `_add_dspy_identifier_to_headers`."}],"question_score":97.5,"needs_regrade":false}
